Chloe / Marissa — copying internal pricing guidance. Key points to include in term sheet: 

1) Technical guardrails: price-locked SKUs must be pinned to a model family (e.g., gpt-neoX-20B-v1) and we include a fallback mapping to compatible variants.
2) MFN: we can offer a limited MFN (hosted token SKU) but only if Aurora signs the higher commit (Option B). MFN excludes partner marketplace promotions and channel-specific credits.

4) Invoice mechanics: monthly invoicing against committed bucket; overages billed at locked rate + 20% surge fee unless Aurora opts into auto-burst capacity (separate add-on).

I'll draft wording for the price protection clause and the fallback policies.
